title: Intro to Jupyter
line: Run cells, write notes, draw a chart and share a notebook.

project.title: A notebook report on your own numbers
project.brief: Make a new notebook alone about a month of your own numbers, like sleep hours or spending. Give it a title, notes in Markdown and one chart, then export it as HTML.
checks: After Restart Kernel and Run All Cells no cell shows an error
It has at least two Markdown cells and one chart image in an output
An HTML export is saved next to the notebook

lessons.title: Start Jupyter and run a cell
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Jupyter. Start JupyterLab from the terminal with jupyter lab, make a notebook named steps.ipynb and run one Python cell with Shift+Return.
lessons.passes: steps.ipynb has one code cell with a saved output.

lessons.title: Command mode and edit mode
lessons.goal: Teach the two Jupyter notebook modes and the keys A, B, D D, M and Y by adding cells to steps.ipynb that hold a week of step counts in a list and print the total.
lessons.passes: The notebook has at least three code cells and the last one prints the week's total.

lessons.title: Run order and what the kernel keeps
lessons.goal: Teach how a Jupyter kernel keeps variables between cells and why run order matters, by changing a daily goal in one cell of steps.ipynb and rerunning the cell that compares the steps to it.
lessons.passes: The last output compares the steps against the new goal of 8000.

lessons.title: Write notes in Markdown cells
lessons.goal: Teach Jupyter Markdown cells by giving steps.ipynb a title, a heading for each part, a bullet list that says what the numbers mean and one phrase in bold.
lessons.passes: The notebook has a Markdown title, at least two headings and a bullet list.

lessons.title: Help, tab completion and magics
lessons.goal: Teach finding help inside Jupyter with Tab, Shift+Tab and a question mark, and the %timeit and %whos magics, by timing two ways to total the week of steps.
lessons.passes: Two cells use %timeit and each shows a timing in its output.

lessons.title: Install a package and draw a chart
lessons.goal: Teach installing a package from a Jupyter cell with %pip install matplotlib, then drawing a bar chart of steps per day that shows under the cell, with a title and axis labels.
lessons.passes: A cell calls plt.bar on the seven days and its output holds an image.

lessons.title: Restart and run all
lessons.goal: Teach the Jupyter Kernel menu. Use Restart Kernel and Run All Cells on steps.ipynb, find the cell that fails because it leans on a cell that was deleted, and fix the order.
lessons.passes: Every code cell ran with no error and the run counts go up in order from 1.

lessons.title: Export and share the notebook
lessons.goal: Teach sharing a Jupyter notebook. Rerun steps.ipynb from the top so it is clean, then use Save and Export Notebook As in the File menu to save an HTML copy anyone can open.
lessons.passes: steps.html is saved and holds the chart and the Markdown notes.
